title: Bass numbers of graded components of local cohomology modules
summary: Let $R=\bigoplus_{n\in \NN_0}R_n$ be a standard graded ring, $R_+=\bigoplus_{n\in \NN}R_n$ its irrelevant ideal, and $M$ a finitely generated graded $R$-module. In this paper, we study the asymptotic behavior of the sequence $\{μ^i(\p_0, H^j_{R_+}(M)_n)\}_{n\in \Z}$ of Bass numbers of graded components of local cohomology modules with respect to an ideal $\p_0\in \Spec(R_0)$ in each of the following cases: (1) $i=0$ or $i= 1$ and $j\leq f_{R_+}(M)$, (2) $R_0$ is regular, $i= \hei(\p_0)$ or $i= \hei(\p_0)- 1$ and $j= \cd_{R_+}(M)$, (3) $M$ is relative Cohen-Macaulay with respect to $R_+$.…
